description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the snapshotting functionality of the 'ThingPersistenceActor' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies correct snapshot creation, recovery, and handling of deleted and modified things.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorSnapshottingTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the snapshotting behavior of ThingPersistenceActor, including creation, deletion, recreation, and recovery of 'Thing' objects.

methods.name: deletedThingIsSnapshotWithCorrectDataAndCanBeRecreated
methods.description: Tests that a deleted thing is correctly snapshotted and can be recreated after actor restart, ensuring deletion snapshots are accurate.

methods.name: thingInArbitraryStateIsSnapshotCorrectly
methods.description: Checks that snapshots of a 'Thing' in various states contain correct revision numbers and data, validating snapshot integrity.

methods.name: actorCannotBeStartedWithNegativeSnapshotThreshold
methods.description: Verifies that the actor cannot be initialized with an invalid negative snapshot threshold, ensuring robustness against misconfiguration.
